name: ndr
description: Nested decision records — atomic markdown decision atoms in your Obsidian vault with supersession-aware reading. Capture engineering decisions from any chat (/capture-decision), query the corpus by topic with automatic supersession-chain walking (/decisions <topic>), ground a coding session in relevant prior decisions before edits (/ground), audit code against current decision heads with /drift-check, and bootstrap vault content on first install (/ndr-bootstrap).
